meta.title: End-to-End Automation for Corporate Training | LearnPack
meta.description: Automate course creation, updates, analytics, and tutoring so your team only focuses on the content that matters. AI-powered training lifecycle management.
meta.keywords: training automation, AI course creation, corporate training, SCORM export, LMS integration, employee training, AI tutor, automated learning
meta.ogDescription: Automate course creation, updates, analytics, and tutoring. Let your team focus on content that matters.

hero.title: End-to-end automation for corporate training
hero.subtitle: Automate course creation, updates, analytics, and tutoring so your team only focuses on the content that matters.

definition.text: LearnPack automates the entire lifecycle of corporate training from content creation to delivery, analytics, and continuous updates using AI.

problems.title: What you stop doing manually
problems.subtitle: LearnPack removes the repetitive work from your training workflow.

expensive.title: Authoring courses from scratch
expensive.description: No more rebuilding every slide. Start from documents, videos, or SOPs and let AI generate the first version.

updates.title: Rebuilding content for every update
updates.description: Update a policy or process once and let LearnPack propagate the changes across lessons.

visibility.title: Copy-pasting into multiple tools
visibility.description: Generate, publish, and deliver training from one place without juggling authoring tools, LMS, and slide decks.

completion.title: Chasing learners for completion
completion.description: Track progress automatically and see who is stuck or at risk of dropping out.

support.title: Answering the same questions repeatedly
support.description: Rigobot gives instant, contextual help so managers and trainers do not have to.

features.title: Automation across the training lifecycle
features.subtitle: From the first draft of a course to ongoing updates and learner support.

generation.title: Course generation
generation.description: Turn PDFs, videos, and SOPs into interactive courses with lessons, quizzes, and challenges in minutes.

editing.title: Continuous iteration
editing.description: Use AI to rewrite, simplify, or expand any block of content without opening a design tool.

translations.title: Instant translations
translations.description: Translate an entire course into any language and adapt wording for each audience.

analytics.title: Analytics and alerts
analytics.description: See who is learning, where they struggle, and which modules need improvement in real time.

howItWorks.title: How end-to-end automation works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps and everything else is handled by LearnPack.

step1.title: Input your content or idea
step1.description: Upload documents, videos, or SOPs, or answer four guided questions about topic, audience, and goals.

step2.title: AI builds the course
step2.description: LearnPack generates a structured course with lessons, quizzes, and interactive activities.

step3.title: AI maintains it over time
step3.description: Use Rigobot to update content, add new examples, or translate without starting from zero.

featureTable.title: What LearnPack automates vs what you control
featureTable.subtitle: Automation where it saves the most time. Human control where it matters.

courseGen.title: Course structure
courseGen.description: Automated. LearnPack proposes lessons, activities, and assessments. You approve or tweak.

blockEdit.title: Content wording
blockEdit.description: Co-created. AI suggests text and your subject-matter experts keep the voice and accuracy.

tutor.title: Learner support
tutor.description: Automated. Rigobot answers questions and guides learners with a Socratic approach.

scorm.title: SCORM and LMS delivery
scorm.description: Automated. Packages are generated in SCORM and embedded or exported to your LMS in one click.

multilingual.title: Localization
multilingual.description: Automated. Languages and regional variants are created instantly. You control final terminology and compliance notes.

useCases.title: Where end-to-end automation shines
useCases.subtitle: The same engine adapts to very different training needs.

employee.title: Employee onboarding
employee.description: Launch consistent onboarding paths across locations without rebuilding content.

product.title: Product and sales training
product.description: Keep product modules up to date as features change without re-recording every video.

technical.title: Technical and tools training
technical.description: Turn documentation into interactive labs and challenges that update with each release.

compliance.title: Compliance and policies
compliance.description: Update policies once and automatically reflect them in every affected course.

metrics.title: Measured impact of automation
metrics.subtitle: Based on deployments with training centers and corporate teams.

dropout.label: reduction in learner dropout with Rigobot

testimonial.quote: LearnPack cut our course creation time from weeks to hours without losing quality.
testimonial.author: HR Director

finalCta.title: Ready to automate your training lifecycle?
finalCta.subtitle: Generate your first AI-powered course and let LearnPack handle the heavy lifting from there.
